summary: Account is brand new (9 IG, 2 LI, 1 BS followers). Animated ads is the worst-performing service (0.5x). Reels lose 77% viewers in first 3 seconds — hooks fail. Bio violates rules: niche/region targeting, timeframe claim, free offer outside website posts. Top3 hooks outperform (2.31x); curiosity hooks underperform (0.5x). Lead gen outperforms other services (2.31x). Data too thin for strong patterns (<3 posts per style).
guidance:
- Hook style: use **top3** or **contrast** for animated ads; avoid curiosity (0.5x) and question (underperforms for this service).
- Topic: show a real problem small businesses face with static creatives (low attention, scroll past) — relatable to any business running ads.
- Format: static image or carousel (silhouette style 2.33x) over reel until hook retention improves.
- Tone: developer sharing observation, not selling. End with "pay after approval" + "DM for a quick chat on fit".
- Avoid: niche examples, guaranteed results, demo offers, timeframes, "free audit" language.

instructions.research: Find 2-3 public examples of Indian small businesses (different industries/cities) running static image ads that likely get scrolled past — note the visual sameness, no motion hook.
instructions.analysis: Compare the scroll-stop potential of motion vs static for those examples; identify one concrete visual difference (e.g., product demo motion, price reveal animation, map pin drop) to reference in the post.
instructions.writer: Write a top3-style post: "3 reasons static ad creatives get scrolled past" — each reason a developer observation (file size, no motion cue, same layout as 50 others). No niche names. End: "Pay after you approve. DM if you want a quick take on whether motion helps your offer."
instructions.image: Create a split-frame carousel: left frame static ad (generic), right frame same ad with one motion element highlighted (arrow, fade, slide). Label "Static" / "With motion cue". No client branding. Silhouette/flat style.
instructions.video: Skip reel today. If you record, first 3 seconds must show the motion cue side-by-side with static — no talking head, no logo intro. Caption mirrors the top3 post.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: "Websites, AI chatbots, animated ads & lead gen for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for a quick fit check." (removes niche, region, timeframe, free offer).
Comment on 5 posts from Indian small business owners (any industry) discussing ad creative struggles — add a developer observation, not a pitch.
Reply to the 1 comment on your best-performing chatbot post (Oct 12) with a follow-up tip: "Same logic applies to ad creatives — motion cues stop the scroll."
